useWhen: Read a journal or invoice export an operator already holds (MoneyForward, freee, Yayoi, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Zoho Invoice or FreshBooks), a bank or card statement file the operator downloaded (OFX/QFX/QBO, 全銀 data, freee, MoneyForward, Xero or QuickBooks statement CSV, a bank or card CSV), or a Ramp, Brex, Expensify or BILL export; check that entries balance and accounts are classified, build a trial balance, P&L or balance sheet, compute an invoice's per-rate consumption tax, check a Japanese qualified invoice's required contents, post invoices as journal entries, reconcile statements against the ledger, suggest invoice settlements, matches and journals for statement lines, post the lines the operator approved, or convert to another of these formats
avoidWhen: Reading from or writing to a live accounting company, invoicing service, bank, card issuer, expense or AP service, or tax authority; account aggregation or making payments; verifying a registration number with the NTA (only its T + 13 digits form is checked); sending invoices; posting statement lines the operator has not approved; treating kaikei's class mapping, staged profit, retained-earnings, per-line tax allocation, matching or learned-rule logic as a vendor's calculation; passing a real ledger or statement to an agent whose inference rail is remote (the tools are pure, but the agent turn is not local)

inputs.text: journal, invoice, statement or expense export as text, or bytes_base64 for Shift_JIS files (<= 5 MiB)
inputs.ledger: kaikei.ledger.v1 object returned by kaikei_import (carries invoices, statement accounts and lines, rules and settings)
inputs.lines: invoice lines (amount, tax rate, reduced flag) for kaikei_invoice_totals
inputs.approvals: statement line ids with the choice the operator approved, for kaikei_statement_post

outputs.ledger: kaikei.ledger.v1 (integer minor units, one currency per ledger, invoices and statements included)
outputs.checks: balance-sheet difference, unclassified accounts, invalid entries
outputs.report: trial balance, P&L or balance sheet in kaikei, QuickBooks Report or Xero Reports shape
outputs.invoice: per-rate consideration and tax (one rounding per invoice per rate), qualified-invoice content problems, transitional deduction percent, posted entries
outputs.statement: per-account line status counts, statement against ledger balance, the first running-balance break, receivable and payable aging, and candidates with strength and reasons
outputs.export: text, or bytes_base64 for Shift_JIS, plus notes on fields the format cannot hold

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry and owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-23: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures, 11 tools; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__kaikei__<tool> and does not start MCP subprocesses on peer runs. Data-format compatibility only; no connection to MoneyForward, freee, Yayoi, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Zoho Invoice, FreshBooks, Ramp, Brex, Expensify, BILL, any bank or card issuer, or the NTA publication site.
requires: cloud-itonami/kaikei checkout at the pinned commit

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve the absolute checkout before writing the client config. The launcher finds nbb.edn from its own path and resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text git dependency into ~/.gitlibs; no cwd is required.
